answer: Physical Presence Receipt Chain. Each agent identity must periodically submit a fresh, signed receipt produced by a co-located hardware beacon it physically contacts; beacons are deployed like an orchard of fixed stations, and each receipt carries a unique short-range radio signal tied to that station's location and time window. A zephyr of forged receipts fails because a single operator cannot occupy many stations at once. Cost: one physical site visit per identity per epoch, scaling linearly with clones.
